title: kith-tui: read-only chat UI
description: Wire the JMAP client into the TUI panels. Chat list panel: load chats via Chat/get on startup, display chat name + unread count, navigate with up/down arrows, Enter selects a chat. Message thread panel: load messages for selected chat via Message/query+get, display sender + timestamp + body, newest at bottom, scroll with PgUp/PgDn. Real-time updates: EventSource StateChange triggers Message/changes then reloads affected messages. Status bar shows connection state (Connecting/Connected/Reconnecting) and current chat name.
notes: Review converged after 1 round. Final review: KITH-bitw.
